text.p: These are the leading stories in the Maltese press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Prime Minister Alfred Sant says the government to take "difficult but necessary decisions" this year, underlining that continued growth of the economy was important. He pledges the government will work hard to encourage private initiatives.
- Search for three men missing at sea.
- Man killed in car crash as son follows in another car.
- Hundreds call to exchange greetings with opposition leader Eddie Fenech Adami.
- German tourist dies in hotel room. Foul play not suspected.
